audit_items.proof_trace: The property asserts all student_number values match /^[0-9]+$/, but two update paths break this invariant: (1) profileAdminUpdateSchema (L24-31) applies no regex to student_number, so updateMemberAdmin can write any arbitrary string; (2) profileUpdateSchema (L18-20) uses /^[0-9]*$/ which allows empty string "", permitting self-service users to persist a non-digit value. Only the registerSchema path correctly enforces /^[0-9]+$/.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An authenticated user calls the updateMyProfile server action with student_number="" (empty string) — profileUpdateSchema accepts it and supabaseAdmin writes it to the DB, violating the numeric-only invariant. An admin can go further and set student_number to any arbitrary non-numeric string via updateMemberAdmin.
